{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Count total completed orders (including QA)
total_completed = (data['status'] == 'completed').sum()

# Count completed orders excluding QA orders
completed_excluding_qa = total_completed - len(qa_orders)

# Print results
print("Total completed orders (including QA):", total_completed)
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))
print("Completed orders excluding QA:", completed_excluding_qa)"}
